entities.name: Kalemne
entities.description: A legendary giant soldier of Theros who is a disciple of Iroas and leads giants, dragons and angels by strategy.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of victory and heroism, to whom Kalemne offers her devotion.

relations.note: Disciple of the god of victory.
relations.quote: Kalemne is a disciple of the soldier's god
